d: Congo is battling its deadliest Ebola outbreak on record, with more than 11,000 infections and over 5,300 deaths. The virus has spread across eight provinces and crossed international borders. But armed conflict, attacks on health workers, growing mistrust, and a strained healthcare system are hampering containment efforts. With no approved vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo strain, the fight to stop the outbreak is becoming increasingly difficult.
